Game Overview

Monster Live is a action game built around battle in real-time against relentless undead in Monster Live's thrilling apocalyptic world. Survive solo or team up worldwide, tactically upgrading skills each level. Master quick reflexes and strategic teamwork to fend off brain-hungry hordes while enhancing your character for escalating challenges. Can you outlast the chaos?
